event_chain.summary: Loss of USB drive with veteran records

summary: A USB flash drive containing confidential records of multiple Navajo veterans - Social Security numbers, DD-214 discharge records, ID documents, W-9 forms, financial assistance applications and direct-deposit information - was found at a laundromat in Farmington, New Mexico by another veteran. The Navajo Nation Council acknowledged a potential data breach and handed the device to the FBI in August 2026 while determining responsibility.
